title: denidin-morning config schema
description: Canonical config schema for apps/morning-mcp-app/config/config.json. FLAT shape: the three required credential keys are top-level (matching the real config.example.json / config.test.json and the existing sandbox integration tests, which read them flat). All runtime config comes from this file per CONSTITUTION §I (no environment variables).

api_key_id.description: Morning API key id, used in the /account/token JWT exchange.

api_key_secret.description: Morning API key secret, used in the /account/token JWT exchange.

api_url.description: Base URL for the Morning REST API. Sandbox: https://sandbox.d.greeninvoice.co.il/api/v1/ ; Production: https://api.greeninvoice.co.il/api/v1/

file_upload_url.description: Optional: Morning file-upload gateway base URL (separate domain). Reserved for the future receipt-parsing feature (017); not used by the 8 invoice tools.

token_ttl_seconds.description: Assumed JWT lifetime; MorningAuth caches the token for this long.

refresh_before_seconds.description: Refresh the token when it is within this many seconds of expiry.

rate_limit_per_second.description: Client-side rate limit to stay under Morning's ~3 req/s (429) ceiling.

enable_mcp_server.description: Gate for starting the FastMCP server. When false, the server entrypoint does not start; the existing client library and its integration tests are unaffected.
